title: Vault Dynamic Secrets
description: Issues database and cloud credentials on demand with Vault dynamic secrets. Each lease is unique, short-lived, and revoked automatically; there are no shared passwords to leak. It eliminates static credentials.

demo.title: Demo — Vault Dynamic Secrets

title: Short TTL Policies
description: Sets aggressive time-to-live policies so stolen credentials die quickly. Minutes, not months; the TTL matches the task duration. Short lifetimes shrink every breach.

demo.title: Demo — Short TTL Policies

title: Just-in-Time Credentials
description: Provisions credentials at the moment of need and destroys them after. No credential exists before the task or after it; the window of exposure is the task itself. It is zero standing privilege in practice.

demo.title: Demo — Just-in-Time Credentials

title: OIDC Authentication
description: Authenticates vault clients with OIDC so humans and workloads prove identity without passwords. The vault trusts the identity provider's tokens; roles map claims to policies. It unifies human and machine auth.

demo.title: Demo — OIDC Authentication

title: Secret Rotation Automation
description: Rotates secrets automatically on schedule and on events like employee departure. Rotation updates every consumer atomically; old values stop working. Automation is what makes rotation actually happen.

demo.title: Demo — Secret Rotation Automation

title: Lease Management
description: Manages secret leases with renewal, revocation, and expiry. Leases are the unit of ephemeral access; the manager tracks them all. Orphaned leases get reaped.

demo.title: Demo — Lease Management

title: Audit Logging
description: Logs every secret access with who, what, and when for forensics. Tamper-evident audit devices preserve the trail; every issuance is accountable. It answers who had what, when.

demo.title: Demo — Audit Logging

title: Transit Encryption
description: Encrypts data in transit through the vault without storing keys in the app. The transit engine encrypts and decrypts on request; apps never see keys. It centralizes crypto correctly.

demo.title: Demo — Transit Encryption

title: PKI as a Service
description: Issues short-lived certificates from the vault's PKI engine. Services get TLS certs valid for hours, rotated automatically; there are no year-long certs to forget. It makes mTLS practical.

demo.title: Demo — PKI as a Service

title: Database Credential Brokering
description: Brokers database credentials so apps never know the real password. The vault creates per-app database users with least privilege and rotates them. Database access becomes auditable per app.

demo.title: Demo — Database Credential Brokering

title: Kubernetes Integration
description: Injects vault secrets into Kubernetes pods via agents and CSI drivers. Pods authenticate with service accounts; secrets never touch etcd. It is the Kubernetes-native secrets story.

demo.title: Demo — Kubernetes Integration

title: Break-Glass Procedures
description: Defines break-glass access for emergencies with mandatory review after. Sealed emergency credentials exist but using them pages security; every use is investigated. It balances availability with accountability.

demo.title: Demo — Break-Glass Procedures

title: Zero Standing Privileges
description: Eliminates standing privileges entirely: no account has access until it requests it. Every privilege is just-in-time, scoped, and expiring. It is the end state of privileged access management.

demo.title: Demo — Zero Standing Privileges

title: HSM-Backed Vaults
description: Backs vault master keys with HSMs so the root of trust is hardware. Unsealing needs the HSM; attackers need the hardware too. It hardens the vault itself.

demo.title: Demo — HSM-Backed Vaults

title: Vault Disaster Recovery
description: Replicates vaults across sites with tested failover for secrets availability. DR secondaries stay in sync; failover is practiced. Secrets must survive disasters too.

demo.title: Demo — Vault Disaster Recovery
